# Annular webs and Guralnick's conjecture

> Mathematical paper by Tom Goertzen, Abel Lacabanne, Daniel Tubbenhauer and Pedro Vaz. An explicit family of ordinary affine Kazhdan–Lusztig mu-coefficients with fixed source w_0 has sum m(m+1)/2. For each m >= 2 and all sufficiently large primes p, these coefficients are first cohomology dimensions of faithful absolutely irreducible PSL_{2m+1}(F_p)-modules. Companion snapshot: 2026-11-03.

The main theorem proves a row sum. The individual formula mu_{j;m}=j is not proved for general m. The characteristic threshold may depend on m. The manuscript and its stated hypotheses determine the claims; the guide provides navigation. This file follows the llms.txt proposal and is an additional entry point, not a crawler policy or a promise of indexing.

## Read individual sections

- [Introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/01-introduction.md): Problem, endpoints, theorem and reported verification.
- [Webs and KL coefficients](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/02-annular-webs-and-kl-coefficients.md): Categories, normalizations, bases and coefficient readout.
- [The main web](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/03-the-main-web.md): Six maps, symmetrizers and flag counts.
- [The main calculation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/04-the-base-change-main-calculation.md): Six families, canonical correction and the row-sum proof.
- [The first example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/05-the-first-example-in-pictures.md): The m=2 calculation.
- [First cohomology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/06-application-to-guralnick-s-conjecture.md): Highest weights, transfer hypotheses and the finite simple quotient.
- [Methods and AI assistance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/07-methods-and-ai-assistance.md): Discovery history.
- [References](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtubbenhauer/mutwo/main/ai/sections/08-references.md): The manuscript bibliography with source links.
